# Chatrio

> Chatrio is a free, anonymous web app that instantly pairs you with a random
> stranger for a private 1-on-1 text or video chat with a real human — no account,
> no app download, no phone number, and no bots. It is a modern, browser-based
> Omegle alternative. Chatrio also offers "Circles": free anonymous local chat
> that shows who's nearby (approximate area only, never an exact location), lets
> you send one intro message before a chat opens, and supports local group rooms
> — also no account required. "Blind Date" is a one-on-one blind-dating chat
> feature (text and video) for users with a real Chatrio account.

## Facts
- Price: 100% free. No subscription, no premium tiers, no hidden costs.
- Sign-up: Not required for random chat, random video chat, or Circles — no
  account for any of them. Blind Date is the one feature that requires a real
  Chatrio account.
- Anonymous: No name, email, or phone number needed for random chat, video chat,
  or Circles; Circles uses a browser-local anonymous ID plus a chosen nickname,
  not real identity.
- Real humans, not AI: Every chat partner on Chatrio is a real person matched in
  real time — there are no chatbots or AI-generated conversation partners.
- Privacy: Random-chat messages are delivered in real time and never stored.
- Matching: Optional interest/topic-based matching (gaming, music, travel, etc.)
  for random chat; Circles matches by approximate proximity instead.
- Platform: Works in any modern browser on desktop, iOS, and Android. No install.
- Features: Text, image sharing, typing indicators, delivery receipts, skip/next,
  plus live random video chat.
- Age requirement: Strictly 18+ sitewide. A one-time age confirmation is shown
  before entering chat, video chat, Circles, or Blind Date.
- Circles safety: approximate location only (never shown on a map), one intro
  message before a chat opens (declining blocks the sender), report/block anytime.
- Positioning: A cleaner, mobile-first, privacy-focused alternative to Omegle
  (the original Omegle shut down permanently in November 2023; the domain changed
  ownership in mid-2026 and now hosts an unrelated product, not a revival),
  Chatroulette, and OmeTV.

## Use cases
- Talk to a stranger when bored or lonely, instantly and anonymously, by text or video.
- Meet new people worldwide without revealing your identity.
- Find someone who shares your interests via topic-based matching.
- See who's anonymously nearby and start a local chat or group room via Circles.
- Try a one-on-one blind date (text or video) without seeing a profile first.
- Look up modern dating/chat slang (DTR, orbiting, triangulation, curving,
  kitten fishing, negging, weaponized incompetence, compersion, and more) in
  the dating & chat slang glossary.
